ruling: PROCEED, overriding HOLD, with a qualified prior-art limitation. Reasons: (1) the D gap is that the published journal versions of record (Li-Weng, Bull. Malays. Math. Sci. Soc. 44 (2021); Weng, Graphs and Combinatorics 40 (2024)) were not read; campaign precedent accepts this qualification (352827 DAM body unread; 359279 JCTA body unread; 338887 AMS body not accessed); (2) the arXiv v2 body, an author-hosted 2021 manuscript retaining Conjecture 6.12 with n >= 8, the arXiv version of the 2024 follow-up, the 2018 introductory paper and all seven OpenAlex citing records were read or screened with no refutation found; (3) failures at order 9 (three verified extensions) mean even a changed threshold would still be refuted. scope: Credit for refuting Conjecture 6.12 (v2; Conjecture 5.12 in v1) of arXiv:2004.06285 via the explicit order-8 pair; the order-9 failures and the 74 order-8 classes are supporting evidence, not separate credit.
